description:
Connects to the target with a 10 second timeout and checks the version (MySQL 8.0, MariaDB 10.6 or PostgreSQL 13 or newer), that the database has no tables, that the user can create and drop a table, and that it is not the database in use. It changes nothing on the target. 409 while a move runs or when the connection comes from the DB_* environment variables. Errors carry a database.error.<code> message id: invalid-target, connect, timeout, version, not-empty, permission, same-database, env-locked, move-running.
Needs: an administrator (a token needs its Administrator switch)

200.description: The target can be used: its engine, server version and flavor (null for SQLite)

version.description: The server version of the target; null for SQLite.

flavor.description: mysql, mariadb or postgres, as the server reports itself; null for SQLite.
